rawContent: We as parents, teachers & students stand in solidarity & hold @UFT President Michael Mulgrew @UFTUnity & all voting members accountable for a lack of meaningful action around @Blm_edu_nyc Now is the time to stand with us & foster culturally responsive schools! #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/QVTGnAmjOr

Before Covid 19 made it abundantly clear that our system was riddled with inequity, many of our teachers, students & families were already engaging with #BlackLivesMatter at school. The @UFT has an obligation to commit to the #YearOfPurpose & #WeekOfAction as our largest union! https://t.co/vqWNBK4uV7

Teachers cannot simultaneously be essential & siloed. That is why parents & students have joined @Blm_edu_nyc to make their voices heard. Given the inequities surfaced by Covid 19 @UFT has a moral obligation to adopt #BlackLivesMatter at School. Will UFT rise to the occasion?

President Mulgrew of the @UFT has disappointed teachers, students & parents alike this summer. As a show of good faith to our communities, we demand the UFT FINALLY vote YES to adopt #BlackLivesMatter at school week of action as the largest union! #PutUpOrShutUp #BeMoreLikeMORE https://t.co/eU03ZtzTks

Each year for the past 3 yrs @MOREcaucusUFT & @Blm_edu_nyc have brought a resolution to adopt #BlackLivesMatter at school to the @UFT delegate assembly. This year UFT tweeted BLM. Will they finally back their rhetoric with action? Vote YES on resolution adopting BLM wk of action! https://t.co/9dIRVzSqRJ

If health & safety are the most important thing to @UFT that includes our students & teachers mental health. We cannot discuss socio emotional wellness w/o culturally competent schools. At this weeks delegate assembly the UFT must adopt #BlackLivesMatter At School @Blm_edu_nyc https://t.co/TFp9gyBwMe

Parent leaders, students & our beloved teachers stand together in solidarity against a system that erases our children’s history & provides resources based on zip codes. @Blm_edu_nyc is doing ESSENTIAL work and it’s time the @UFT adopted #BlackLivesMatter wk of action as a union!

Here’s to hoping this is FINALLY the year @UFT votes YES to adopt #BlackLivesMatter at School in its entirety without watering down this opportunity to model cultural competence as our largest union! You tweeted BLM now PROVE it! @Blm_edu_nyc @MOREcaucusUFT https://t.co/9DcWHAbrIO

Parents, teachers & students demand action! We need a YES vote on @Blm_edu_nyc’s resolution to adopt #BlackLivesMatter at school week of action from our largest union.Set an example & stand in solidarity with communities most impacted by Covid 19!#BeMoreLikeMORE #MakeAMoveMulgrew
